English: The public is informed about the Social Health Authority (SHA) registration for universal health coverage.
Kiswahili: Umma unafahamishwa kuhusu usajili wa Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii (SHA) kwa bima ya afya kwa wote.
Dholuo: Oganda ong’eyo wach mar ndiko nying’ e Ofis mar Thieth mar Oganda (SHA) mondo oyud thieth mar ji duto.
Somali: Dadweynaha waxaa lala socodsiinayaa wax ku saabsan diiwaangelinta Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada (SHA) ee caymiska caafimaadka caalamiga ah.

English: The public is informed about the Linda Mama programme providing free maternity care at public health facilities.
Kiswahili: Umma unafahamishwa kuhusu mpango wa Linda Mama unaotoa huduma za uzazi bila malipo katika vituo vya afya vya umma.
Dholuo: Oganda ong’ere kuom chenro mar Linda Mama ma chiwo thieth mar nyuol ma nono e kuonde thieth mag oganda.
Somali: Dadweynaha waxaa lala socodsiinayaa barnaamijka Linda Mama oo daryeelka hooyada ee bilaashka ah ka bixinaya xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha.

English: The public is informed about routine childhood immunization under the Kenya Expanded Programme on Immunization (KEPI).
Kiswahili: Umma unafahamishwa kuhusu chanjo za kawaida za watoto chini ya Mpango wa Kenya wa Chanjo (KEPI).
Dholuo: Oganda ng’eyo kuom chiwo thieth ma pile ka pile ne nyithindo e bwo chenro mar chiwo thieth ma pile ka pile e bwo chenro mar chiwo thieth (KEPI).
Somali: Dadweynaha waxaa lagu wargeliyaa tallaalka joogtada ah ee carruurnimada ee hoos yimaada Barnaamijka Balaadhinta Tallaalka ee Kenya (KEPI).

English: The public is informed about free tuberculosis (TB) diagnosis and treatment at public health facilities.
Kiswahili: Umma unafahamishwa kuhusu uchunguzi na matibabu ya kifua kikuu (TB) bila malipo katika vituo vya afya vya umma.

Somali: Dadweynaha waxa lala socodsiinayaa ogaanshaha iyo daawaynta tiibishada bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha.

English: The public is informed about distribution of long-lasting insecticidal mosquito nets to prevent malaria.
Kiswahili: Umma unafahamishwa kuhusu usambazaji wa vyandarua vinavyodumu kwa muda mrefu kuzuia malaria.

Somali: Dadweynaha waxaa lagu wargelinayaa qaybinta maro-kaneecada cayayaanka ee muddada dheer si looga hortago duumada.

English: The public is informed about HPV vaccination for adolescent girls to prevent cervical cancer.
Kiswahili: Umma unafahamishwa kuhusu chanjo ya HPV kwa wasichana balehe kuzuia saratani ya shingo ya kizazi.

Dholuo: Opis mag gwenge loso tich mar loko skul mar sekondari matin (JSS) e bwo chenro mar somo ma ochung’ne nyalo (CBC), kwayo mag pesa mag NG-CDF ne jopuonjre ma nigi dwaro kokalo kuom opis mag gwenge, kod ndiko penj mar KCSE kod KCPE kokalo kuom bura mar penj mag piny Kenya (KNEC).
Somali: Xafiisyada maxalliga ah ayaa isku dubaridinaya dadaallada loogu gudbayo Dugsiga Sare (JSS) ee hoos yimaada Manhajka Ku-saleysan Kartida (CBC), codsiyada NG-CDF ee deeqaha waxbarasho ee ardayda baahan iyada oo loo marayo xafiisyada deegaanka, iyo diiwaangelinta imtixaannada KCSE iyo KCPE iyada oo loo marayo Golaha Imtixaannada Qaranka ee Kenya (KNEC).

Dholuo: Oboke ma ng’ato nyalo ng’ado e dwe mar ang’wen, ogolo ler kuom kwayo barupe mag sirkal kokalo kuom mbui mar eCitizen, keto ywak mag ng’ado bura ne jopolisi e Od Romo mar ng’ado bura (IPOA), kod ng’ado bura mar sirkal mar piny mangima (NGAAF) ne jogo ma nigi pek.
Somali: Warbixintan kooban ee rubucani waxa ay iftiiminaysaa codsashada dukumentiyada rasmiga ah iyada oo loo marayo madal online eCitizen ah, u gudbinta cabashooyinka kormeerka bilayska ee Maamulka Kormeerka Bilayska ee Madaxbanaan (IPOA), iyo Taageerada Sanduuqa Waxqabadka Xaqiijinta ee Dawladda (NGAAF) ee kooxaha nugul.
